requirements.text: The subscription_admin role can send a valid subscription creation request to POST /api/v2/subscriptions and receives HTTP 201 with code SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED.
The plan_manager role can send a valid plan-change request to PATCH /api/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/plan and receives HTTP 200 with code PLAN_CHANGED.
The invoice_manager role can send a valid invoice issue request to POST /api/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/invoices and receives HTTP 201 with code INVOICE_ISSUED.
The billing_manager role can send a valid invoice finalization request to POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/finalize and receives HTTP 200 with code INVOICE_FINALIZED.
The collections_operator role can send a valid payment-attempt request to POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/payment-attempts and receives HTTP 202 with code PAYMENT_QUEUED.
The billing_manager role can send a valid invoice void request to POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/void and receives HTTP 200 with code INVOICE_VOIDED.

The subscription_admin role calling POST /api/v2/subscriptions accepts seat_count as an integer from 1 through 500 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED at either boundary; seat_count values 0 and 501 return HTTP 422 with code SEAT_COUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE.

The subscription_admin role calling POST /api/v2/subscriptions accepts trial_days as an integer from 0 through 60 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED at either boundary; trial_days values -1 and 61 return HTTP 422 with code TRIAL_DAYS_OUT_OF_RANGE.

The plan_manager role calling PATCH /api/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/plan accepts billing_day as an integer from 1 through 28 inclusive and returns HTTP 200 with code PLAN_CHANGED at either boundary; billing_day values 0 and 29 return HTTP 422 with code BILLING_DAY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

The invoice_manager role calling POST /api/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/invoices accepts invoice_line_count as an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code INVOICE_ISSUED at either boundary; invoice_line_count values 0 and 101 return HTTP 422 with code INVOICE_LINE_COUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE.

The collections_operator role calling POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/payment-attempts accepts retry_attempt as an integer from 0 through 5 inclusive and returns HTTP 202 with code PAYMENT_QUEUED at either boundary; retry_attempt values -1 and 6 return HTTP 422 with code RETRY_ATTEMPT_OUT_OF_RANGE.

The billing_manager role calling POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/finalize accepts adjustment_cents as an integer from -50000 through 50000 inclusive and returns HTTP 200 with code INVOICE_FINALIZED at either boundary; adjustment_cents values -50001 and 50001 return HTTP 422 with code ADJUSTMENT_CENTS_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The analyst role calling POST /api/v2/subscriptions is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The support_agent role calling PATCH /api/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/plan is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The viewer role calling POST /api/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/invoices is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The billing_clerk role calling POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/finalize is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The partner role calling POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/payment-attempts is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The auditor role calling POST /api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/void is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
